requirements.requirement: The system must include an 'experience_measure' object in the provider detail API response when provider data is successfully retrieved.
The system must populate 'experience_measure.derived_years_in_practice' using the output from the years-in-practice calculation logic.
The system must populate 'experience_measure.normalized_experience_score' using the normalized score from the calculation logic.
The system must include original input fields ('graduation_year' and/or 'enumeration_date') in the experience_measure object when available.
The system must ensure the provider_detail_service returns the experience_measure as part of its domain response object.
The system must ensure evaluate_care_facade includes the experience_measure in the final API response payload without altering existing response structure.
The system must maintain backward compatibility such that existing clients can parse the response without errors when the experience_measure field is added.
The system must serialize the experience_measure object in the same format and naming conventions as defined in the schema contract from EVAL-EXP-001.
The system must return a null or empty experience_measure object when both graduation_year and enumeration_date are unavailable.
The system must not fail the entire provider detail API request if experience_measure computation fails, and must still return core provider data.
The system must log an internal warning when experience_measure computation fails or produces invalid values.
The system must ensure the experience_measure fields are numeric and within expected bounds before including them in the API response.
The system must preserve existing provider detail response latency within acceptable thresholds after adding the experience_measure integration.
The system must correctly map experience_measure into any downstream tool or LLM response models used by evaluate_care_facade.
The system must ensure that LLM-facing responses include the experience_measure in a structured, non-ambiguous format suitable for reasoning.
The system must ensure that LLM-facing responses avoid duplicating or conflicting experience-related fields outside the experience_measure object.
The system must ensure that LLM-facing responses include both raw years_in_practice and normalized score to support comparative reasoning.
The system must ensure that LLM-facing responses do not hallucinate experience values when the experience_measure is null or missing.
The system must ensure that LLM-facing responses clearly distinguish between derived values and source data within the experience_measure object.
The system must ensure that experience_measure integration does not alter or overwrite unrelated provider attributes in the API response.
